messages:
jonathan: Quick design question — propose a console toggle `auto_version_switch` to let a tenant opt into measured roll-forward when v2 is saturated. Modes: off / soft (probe ~3–5%) / aggressive (route failovers). Thoughts on telemetry, quota attribution, and UX? :thinking:

maria: Can you confirm billing semantics? If a probe hits v1, do we bill v1 rates and decrement v1 quota? How will that show up in the console?

kevin: We should bill for the model that actually served the request. So yes, v1 tokens count toward v1 quota/pricing. Otherwise billing reconciliation becomes impossible.

sasha: Major perf note: naive random 5% probes will break KV cache locality and spike tail latency. We should cohort-sample (hash by session/tenant) and keep probes sticky for a short window.

jonathan: Agreed. Rough config idea below — feedback welcome:

```
auto_version_switch:
  mode: soft
  probe_pct: 5
  sampling: cohort_hash(session_id, salt)
  sticky_duration: 15m
  metric_labels: ["probe=true", "probe_cohort=<id>"]
```

kevin: Telemetry needs: `version_switch.probe` span tag + per-variant latency histograms. Also increment counter `version_switch.fallbacks{model=<name>}` when we route to a fallback.

maria: For Console UX: show an "Estimated cost delta" before enabling for a tenant. We can run a historical-simulate using recent token distribution x model rates and show median/95th.

dave: Add a guard: if fallback model consumption would exceed tenant's reserved quota, show a warning and block aggressive mode. Also add a warning if enabling will increase billing variability.

kevin: Edge case: if v1 enforces stricter per-tenant rate limits and probe pushes them over, we need an internal backoff path (throttle or queue). We must surface that in the UI and telemetry.

sasha: Security/audit: don't expose the probe header to customers. Use an internal-only header `x-rwd-probe` and strip at the edge. Also record probe cohorts in audit logs for debugging.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staged rollout scheduled — infra sampling config will land in canary next week. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 :rocket:

jonathan: One more ask: make trace sampling adjustable per-tenant. Some tenants want full trace for 1% probes; others want none. Add `trace_pct` alongside `probe_pct`.

kevin: Yes — and keep `trace_pct` <= `probe_pct` by default to limit logging costs. Suggest default `trace_pct = min(0.5%, probe_pct)`.

maria: Action items assigned: (1) Console flags + UI mock (maria), (2) metrics + pricing calc (kevin), (3) sampling impl + sticky logic (sasha), (4) docs & audit changes (jonathan). I'll sketch the UI copy.

jonathan: I'll open an RFC with these details and link the PRs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
